# Hook events

Payload and return summaries describe the wire schema. Local author callbacks also carry HookContext/getSurface; observe handlers return void and require normalization to wire null. Author types and the normalization boundary are documented in [the hook authoring types](../src/hooks.ts).

| Event | Mode | Category | Failure | Timeout ms | Replay | Payload | Return |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `session_start` | parallel | observe | open | 500 | ✓ | [SessionStartPayload](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/SessionStartPayload): type: object; required: reason, preset, cwd; optional: parent | [SessionStartReturn](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/SessionStartReturn): type: null |
| `resources_discover` | waterfall | transform | open | 1000 | ✓ | [ResourcesDiscoverPayload](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/ResourcesDiscoverPayload): type: object; required: actor, cwd, registered | [ResourcesDiscoverReturn](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/ResourcesDiscoverReturn): type: object; optional: resources, additionalContext |
| `before_step` | serial | directive | closed | 1000 | – | [BeforeStepPayload](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/BeforeStepPayload): type: object; required: turn, step, budget, depth | [BeforeStepReturn](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/BeforeStepReturn): type: object; optional: block, reason |
| `context` | waterfall | transform | closed | 1500 | – | [ContextPayload](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/ContextPayload): type: object; required: sections, surfaceDigest | [ContextReturn](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/ContextReturn): A participant returns only the sections it is contributing; sections already contributed by an earlier participant (or present before this hook ran) are kept automatically unless this participant's own sections list an id that matches one of them, in which case that whole row (order, text, source) is replaced by this participant's version. There is no need to read the incoming section list and echo it back. |
| `before_request` | waterfall | transform | closed | 1500 | – | [BeforeRequestPayload](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/BeforeRequestPayload): type: object; required: request, slot, model, attempt | [BeforeRequestReturn](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/BeforeRequestReturn): type: object; optional: patch |
| `before_provider_headers` | waterfall | transform | closed | 500 | – | [BeforeProviderHeadersPayload](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/BeforeProviderHeadersPayload): type: object; required: route, headers | [BeforeProviderHeadersReturn](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/BeforeProviderHeadersReturn): type: object; optional: headers |
| `request_error` | parallel | observe | open | 500 | – | [RequestErrorPayload](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/RequestErrorPayload): type: object; required: code, message, attempt, retryable | [RequestErrorReturn](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/RequestErrorReturn): type: null |
| `tool_call` | serial | directive | closed | 2000 | – | [ToolCallPayload](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/ToolCallPayload): type: object; required: toolUseId, name, args, meta, actor, taint; optional: resolvedPolicy, executionDomain, definitionFingerprint, policyHash | [ToolCallReturn](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/ToolCallReturn): oneOf: 2 branches |

| `turn_stopping` | serial | directive | open | 1000 | – | [TurnStoppingPayload](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/TurnStoppingPayload): type: object; required: turn, step, proposedReason; optional: plan, verifier | [TurnStoppingReturn](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/TurnStoppingReturn): oneOf: 2 branches |
| `approval_request` | waterfall | transform | closed | 1000 | – | [ApprovalRequestPayload](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/ApprovalRequestPayload): type: object; required: request | [ApprovalRequestReturn](../../protocol/schema/hooks.json#/$defs/ApprovalRequestReturn): type: object; optional: request |
